scope: Local public Atheum API; fixed Function with synthetic ontology knowledge

requirements.execution_and_restart: Accepted IDs, durable successful result, independent stored effect and history/result read by a fresh VM
requirements.duplicate_acceptance: Concurrent identical calls share one invocation; repeat run cannot create another attempt; conflicting input rejected
requirements.invalid_input: Invalid Function input rejected before invocation creation and effect
requirements.unknown_result: Committed effect with lost response remains unresolved/unknown; permitted recovery preserves original version
requirements.interrupted_execution: Worker death after effect retains call intent and unknown; explicit recovery reuses exact receipt
